sections.name: Etapp 4 Lappudden-Ullånger

difficulty.fieldReportNotes: Field reports support a medium route with material road/asphalt/gravel, forest/lake trail, and strenuous climbs around Ringråberget/Erikskojan, especially in heat.

start.label: Lappudden
start.source: Höga Kusten GPX / Naturkartan GPX first point

end.label: Ullånger
end.source: Höga Kusten GPX / Naturkartan GPX last point

caveats: Current official page and Naturkartan visible title use Etapp 4 Lappudden-Ullånger, while Naturkartan URL/GPX slug and multiple field/route-app sources use old Etapp 5 naming.
Current official sources list 14.6 km, Medel/Blå, 6-7 h. Legacy official PDF/guide materials list about 15 km, Krävande, 5-6 h.
OSM relation 19096561 starts about 216.6 m from the official GPX start at Lappudden and computes about 0.5 km shorter overall.
Official section 4 GPX end and section 5 GPX start differ by about 24.8 m near Ullånger.
Facilities lane included a lower-latitude coordinate for Nordingrå Vallen, while transit lane and a main-thread Naturkartan Hitta hit check place the bus stop around 62.93087,18.29521.
Official/Naturkartan sources list natural water near Erikskojan/Ringråberget; multiple field reports say it has been dry, muddy, or not drinkable in some years.
Older official guide/FAQ-style sources describe a dry toilet, while at least one 2023 field report says there was no toilet at the cabin.

Nordingrå is presented under Länsstyrelsen's naturreservat/besöksmål pages and WFS as a naturvårdsområde, but Länsstyrelsen says it is not an ordinary nature reserve and rules do not regulate visitor recreation.
Official section page mentions summer boat connection from Ullånger to Ulvön, but the section itself requires no ferry and 2026 boat timetable was not verified.
Before normalization, recheck Din Tur line 217/218/221/270 service and coach schedules for the intended season/date.
Before publication/import, recheck 2026 Höga Kusten Båtarna / M/F Ulvön schedules if showing Ullånger-Ulvön onward access.
Treat Erikskojan spring as untreated and seasonal-uncertain; import the dry toilet only as medium confidence unless fresher local confirmation is found.

Decide whether side trips Fäberget, Per-Olsbo, Grottstigen and Via Ferrata should be imported as POIs/routes or kept as section-detail metadata.

difficulty.fieldReportNotes: Field evidence supports demanding handling because the short route includes rocks, roots, elevation, the Slåttdalsberget alternative around Slåttdalsskrevan, slippery wet surfaces, spring snow/ice and summer crowding.

end.label: Entré Nord Skuleskogens nationalpark

caveats: Höga Kusten labels the section Medel, while Naturkartan/API labels it Röd - krävande and park/field evidence describes demanding terrain.

Current trail pages say passing through the cleft is no longer recommended due to rockfall risk; field reports often say closed; national-park attraction pages still promote the sight without foregrounding the trail-page warning as strongly.
Several sources retain old Skuleberget-Köpmanholmen or Köpmanholmen-Örnsköldsvik staging, while current section 7 is Entré Syd-Entré Nord.
Naturkartan indicates grill/fireplace at Entré Syd, while national-park services guidance says South Entrance has benches and nearby Kälsviken has fireplaces.
Park has natural streams and lakes, but official guidance says no food/water refill and streams are untreated and may dry in dry summers.
Neither endpoint has direct fixed transit in current findings; older Nationalparksbussen/Världsarvsbussen references exist but no 2026 service was confirmed.

Model Slåttdalsskrevan as hazard / avoid-through-passage / use current route; no formal legal closure notice was found in checked official pages, so only strengthen wording if a later formal notice is found.
Do not import a separate Entré Syd fireplace POI unless another official fire POI appears; keep the Naturkartan grill/fireplace claim as endpoint amenity note.
Kälsviken and Tärnättvattnen have no discrete dependable potable-water POI; import natural/side water only where the relevant spur or side facility is modeled.
Normalize Näske and Naturum/Skuleberget bus stops against authoritative Trafiklab/ResRobot stop IDs if API access becomes available.
Suppress Nationalparksbussen/Världsarvsbussen for 2026 unless a new official timetable appears; recheck DinTur/Ybuss before final public guidance.

Official name says Balesuddens naturreservat, but the GPX endpoint is precisely at the Sandlågan/north Balesudden access area and section 9 continues from the same point.
The current section is split across old OSM stages Skuleberget-Köpmanholmen and Köpmanholmen-Örnsköldsvik; route apps also keep old segment labels.

Länsstyrelsen lists Balesudden as 918 ha while Naturkartan/Höga Kusten sources list 923 ha.
Hålviken/Näske toilet points and Köpmanholmen beach/harbor shelter records have incomplete or overlapping coordinates/names.

Normalize Näske, Köpmanholmen and Bäckvägen against authoritative Trafiklab/ResRobot stop IDs if API access becomes available; suppress Genesön as transit unless a real stop area and useful service are later verified.
Use Hålviken and Näske cluster-level toilet records only unless separate toilet coordinates are later found.
Dedupe Köpmanholmen beach/harbor records into one Nässjöbäcken beach/rest cluster plus optional ArkNat alias.
Import Balesudden viewpoint where appropriate; keep Balestjärnen/Balesberget as side-trip metadata unless side-route geometry is modeled.

sourceSummary.classification: navigation-grade with simplification and source-link caveats

caveats: Naturkartan URL slug says etapp-8, but page title/content and current official structure identify the route as Etapp 9.
The visible Höga Kusten section-9 page embeds /gpx/etapp8nord-balesudden.gpx, which is section 8 geometry from Entré Nord to Sandlågan/Balesudden.
Older sources split this area into Sandlågan-Svedje/Småtjärnarna and Svedje/Småtjärnarna-Örnsköldsvik, while OSM relation 19096558 is old Köpmanholmen-Örnsköldsvik staging.
Höga Kusten transport/access text names Köpmanholmen C, but the current section starts at Sandlågan/Balesudden; Köpmanholmen is not the section-9 start.
Current Naturkartan says the stage goal is Stadsträdgården, while older or generic city-access references may point to Stora Torget or Resecentrum.

Länsstyrelsen destination page has no current destination news, but municipal sources say Hörnsjön lighted tracks are out of function until further notice after storm damage, with 2026 restoration/lighting work.
Hörnsjön has overlapping rest/shelter/fire/toilet/parking/natural-water POIs, and facility sources contain tent-site signals while rules lane found no clear camping permission.
Naturkartan and OSM coordinates for Varvsberget viewpoint/restaurant differ by roughly 200 m, and restaurant current opening may be seasonal.
Småtjärnsstugan has no spring/no drinking water; Hörnsjön is natural/cooking water; start has no verified drinking-water tap; services are in Hörnett/Örnsköldsvik.
Do not use the Höga Kusten section-9 page's embedded GPX unless it is fixed; use Naturkartan GPX and/or direct hidden etapp9balesudden-ovik GPX.

Normalize Bäckvägen, Svedjeholmen, Örnparken and Resecentrum against authoritative Trafiklab/ResRobot stop IDs if API access becomes available; suppress Genesön as transit unless a real stop area and useful service are later verified.
Import one Hörnsjön rest cluster plus water/parking; keep tent-site as pending or low-confidence attribute rather than normalized campground unless rules are clarified.
